notes: Published manifest has 11 sections (45 blocks). sec-01/02/03 (current and circuit, potential difference, circuit diagrams) are NCERT 11.1-11.3 under electric-current-and-potential; sec-04 is 11.4 Ohm's law; sec-05 is 11.5 resistance/resistivity; sec-06/07 are 11.6.1/11.6.2 series and parallel; sec-08/09/10 are 11.7-11.8 heating effect, its applications and electric power; sec-11 is the mixed-practice section that spans the whole chapter and is mapped to resistors-in-series-and-parallel because its problems are mostly series/parallel combinations with Ohm's law. Every block is mapped by its section id; A2 fails on any unmapped section or orphan concept.
